exercise.name: Weighted Chin-Up
steps: Hang a plate from a dip belt, or hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Grip the bar palms facing you, hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull until your chin clears the bar, then lower slowly to straight arms.
exercise.one_line_summary: Pull-up bar, palms facing him, hands about shoulder width, a dumbbell squeezed between the feet. Start from a dead hang; end with the chin over the bar, elbows down by the ribs (~145 deg bend). Lats are the target; biceps and upper back help.

setup.target: Palms facing him, hands about shoulder width.
setup.why: Library step 2. S1: the chin-up grip raises biceps and pectoral activity over the pull-up.

setup.target: A dumbbell squeezed between the feet.
setup.tolerance: held by the feet, legs straight

movement.path: Body rises; the bar stays put.
movement.tolerance: chin at or above the bar

muscles.role: Main mover: pulls the upper arms down to the ribs.
muscles.surface: Wide sheet down the side of the back from the armpit to the low back.

muscles.emg: 78-96% MVIC, higher in the chin-up than the pull-up (S1).
Lower trapezius 45-56% MVIC (S1); middle trapezius well active (S2).
muscles.role: Pulls the shoulder blades down and back.
muscles.surface: Between and over the shoulder blades.

mistakes.why_it_matters: Library step 3: chin clears the bar.

sources.citation: Youdas JW, Amundson CL, Cicero KS, et al. 2010. Surface electromyographic activation patterns and elbow joint motion during a pull-up, chin-up, or perfect-pullup rotational exercise. J Strength Cond Res 24(12):3404-3414. doi:10.1519/JSC.0b013e3181f1598c
sources.what_it_gave: Chin-up: latissimus 117-130% MVIC, biceps 78-96%, infraspinatus 71-79%, lower trapezius 45-56%; biceps and pectoralis higher in the chin-up than the pull-up; elbow range ~101 deg.

sources.citation: Snarr RL, Hallmark AV, Casey JC, Esco MR. 2017. Electromyographical comparison of a traditional, suspension device, and towel pull-up. J Hum Kinet 58:5-13. doi:10.1515/hukin-2017-0068
sources.what_it_gave: Pull-up variants at 1.5x bi-acromial grip: latissimus, biceps, posterior deltoid and middle trapezius all well above the hypertrophy threshold; towel grip lowers middle trapezius.
The steps the app shows; the pictures must match them.

clip_check.check: Bar through both fists in both

clip_check.target: chin at/above the bar, head not through it

clip_check.check: Lats strongest red; biceps, upper back lighter
